summary.text: Mike Frantz is the Democratic candidate for Iowa State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican K. Lynn Evans.
Ballotpedia lists him as retired; in a Ballotpedia survey he named education funding, health care access and scientific research among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Mike Frantz graduated from Mount Vernon High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Simpson College in 1986 and a graduate degree from the University of Iowa in 1987, according to Ballotpedia.
He advanced unopposed from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary.
In the survey, Frantz said he wants to stop the private school voucher program and increase investment in K-12 schools, community colleges, public universities and job training.
He also cited Iowa's cancer rates, expanding health care deserts and declining soil and water quality, and said the state should value scientific research.
